body:
APPROACH ARGUMENT FOR STAGE A: HYBRID, WITH ONE MODEL CANDIDATE AND A DETERMINISTIC SCALA COURT.

I reject a wider rule provider: its coverage would remain a property of War of the Ghosts vocabulary. I also reject an unvalidated LLM-only path: fluent output is not evidence, and it would collapse provider plausibility into accepted local semantics.

Proposed first engine: IBM transition-amr-parser behind a new JVM-only provider-parser boundary. Its official repository documents batched sentence parsing to PENMAN plus word-node alignments and Apache-2.0 code. That makes it a good spike candidate, not an approved dependency. Before any model download or committed integration, the spike must pin the parser source SHA, package version, checkpoint identity, checkpoint checksum, source URL, and checkpoint license. If any one is unavailable or incompatible with our distribution posture, the result is a typed blocker and we compare amrlib; we do not silently substitute a model.

Boundary and authority:

1. provider-parser owns subprocess or container I/O. No Python, Torch, AMR implementation, or model type crosses into a portable module.
2. One batch request carries stable sentence/task IDs, exact sentence text/checksum, atlas token IDs/spans, declared parser parameters, seed where meaningful, and timeout budget.
3. The bridge returns a versioned JSON envelope keyed by request ID: provider tokens and declared offset unit, PENMAN with alignment markers, raw model metadata, and process diagnostics. Scala validates ID completeness, token offsets against the exact input text, and checksums the raw envelope.
4. Existing AmrCandidates.fromPenman remains the deterministic authority: PENMAN decode, graph validation, role canonicalisation, strict marker-to-source alignment, and ToChart conversion. A parser output that fails any stage is absent.
5. Each input has exactly one recorded ParserAttempt outcome: Proposed checked PropositionEvidence plus ProviderCall, or a typed Failed or Abstained outcome plus a receipt. I do not intend to force parser calls through AgentCallReceipt because a fake PromptPackageRef would fabricate provenance. Parser proposals remain proposals; only the existing resolver may accept claims.
6. The independent schema-constrained critic is a later hybrid layer for flagged or high-impact candidates. It may emit findings or patches, never replacement truth. No ensemble until disagreement is measured.

COVERAGE DEFINITION: attempted is not covered. The denominator is the 50 atlas sentences. The numerator is only sentences producing a checked PropositionEvidence with exact sentence alignment and a retained call receipt. The report names every miss by sentence index, text, and failing stage. Therefore 50 recorded attempts with 46 failures is still 4/50, while 50/50 means all fifty passed the checked-chart boundary. Neither means 50 accepted truths.

FALSIFIABLE COURT BEFORE CLAIMING THE METHOD:

- Contract/property: batch reorder and chunking preserve ID-keyed outcomes; every input has exactly one outcome; no extra output ID; same pinned model/config/input gives byte-stable canonical output or a recorded nondeterminism failure; cache replay performs zero provider calls and preserves receipts.
- Independent oracle: published AMR guideline examples only, checking decoded graph/isomorphism and exact alignment where the publication supplies it. Parser output is never its own gold.
- Metamorphic: role swap changes ARG structure; negation changes polarity; active/passive preserves the local proposition modulo canonical graph equivalence; direct versus reported speech preserves embedding/context distinction; batching and input order do not change keyed results.
- Adversarial: empty text, fragment, quotation, non-ASCII, repeated-token alignment ambiguity, long sentence, timeout, nonzero exit, malformed JSON, duplicate/missing IDs, malformed PENMAN, invalid graph, and absent/out-of-range markers all produce typed recorded absence.
- Generalisation: WOG is the acceptance corpus, not a tuning set. Freeze provider configuration before its 50-sentence run and run a separate published/open held-out prose set so a WOG-specific lexicon cannot pass.
- Performance: report cold container/model startup separately from warmed batch throughput and peak memory; budgets are evidence from the spike, not invented defaults.

PROPOSED SEQUENCING: first land a no-model contract slice with a fake process transport and all failure/replay courts; then run the pinned-runtime spike and publish the full 50-row WOG ledger plus held-out results; only then decide whether transition-amr-parser is viable or whether the engine needs replacement. I will not reserve implementation paths until the chief and reviewer accept or amend this boundary.
